description: This Java class implements a rule engine node for Thingsboard that saves message data into a custom Cassandra table. It handles message parsing, prepares Cassandra insert statements, and manages asynchronous database writes, with configuration options for table name, field mappings, and TTL.

classes.name: TbSaveToCustomCassandraTableNode
classes.description: A rule engine node for saving message data into a specified Cassandra table with configurable field mappings and TTL.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node, sets up Cassandra session, and prepares the insert statement based on configuration.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, triggers save operation asynchronously.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, nullifies the prepared statement.

methods.name: isTableExists
methods.description: Checks if the target Cassandra table exists in the keyspace.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the Cassandra session.

methods.name: getSaveStmt
methods.description: Creates the prepared insert statement based on field mappings.

methods.name: prepareStatement
methods.description: Builds the insert query string and prepares it.

methods.name: createQuery
methods.description: Constructs the CQL insert statement with placeholders.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Parses message data, maps fields, and executes asynchronous insert into Cassandra.

methods.name: getStmtBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new BoundStatementBuilder from the prepared statement.

methods.name: executeAsyncWrite
methods.description: Executes the Cassandra statement asynchronously with default consistency level.

methods.name: executeAsync
methods.description: Performs async execution of Cassandra statement with specified consistency level.

methods.name: statementToString
methods.description: Converts a statement to its string representation for logging.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Handles configuration upgrades from older versions, adds default TTL if missing.
